title: Physics-informed active learning for inverse design of vacuum coatings
summary: A closed-loop physics-informed active learning framework with a physics-regularized heteroscedastic neural network (PR-HNN) and risk-aware dual-point batch acquisition expanded the Pareto front over three experimental iterations. It yielded CoCrFeNiTi coatings with peak hardness of about 13.4 GPa and minimum wear depth of 0.25 um, and PR-HNN generalization error was 41% lower than data-only baselines. The date is the publisher record date; the number of experiments, baseline hardness and comparison with non-AI optimization are not in the abstract.
ai_technology: Physics-regularized heteroscedastic neural network (PR-HNN) with risk-aware dual-point batch acquisition in closed-loop active learning
